sections.title: Traits

sections.title: Actions
lines:

Frightening Screech (Recharge 5–6). Each creature within 30 ft. that can hear the screech must pass a DC 13 Wisdom save or become frightened of the horror for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. Once it succeeds on the save or the effect ends, it is immune to this horror’s screech for 24 hours.

sections.title: Customizing a Horror
lines:
For a customized Flying Horror, choose or roll one primary and one secondary feature on two d4s.
Primary 1. Avoidance. If a successful save would halve damage, take no damage on a success and half as much on a failure.
Primary 2. Damage Resistances. Gain resistance to necrotic and psychic damage.
Primary 3. Innate Spellcasting. Cast Darkness three times per day using Charisma (spell save DC 13), without material components.
Primary 4. Psychic Rebuke. When a melee attack deals damage to the horror, it can use its reaction to deal 3 (1d6) psychic damage to each creature within 5 ft.
Secondary 1. Grasping Tendrils. The horror has four tendrils (AC 12 and 10 HP each). Destroying one deals no damage to the horror. As a bonus action, choose a creature it can see within 10 ft. The target makes a DC 9 Dexterity save or is grappled (escape DC 9). Each tendril can hold only one target at a time.
Secondary 2. Indomitable Mind. Gain immunity to being charmed.
Secondary 3. Keen Senses. Gain advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight, hearing, or smell.
Secondary 4. Mind Sight. Magical darkness does not impede the horror’s darkvision.

sections.title: Horrors and Madness
lines: If you use the book’s optional madness rule, track each failed save against a Flying Horror’s Frightening Screech, a Shadow Horror’s claw attack, or a Skittering Horror’s Maddening Presence. After the encounter, each character with any such failures makes a DC 13 Wisdom save. Failure causes short-term madness after one tracked failure, long-term madness after two or three, or indefinite madness after four or more. Consult the Dungeon Master’s Guide for the corresponding madness rules.

sections.title: Lair actions
lines:
Golgari Lairs. These actions belong to a group of six or more Golgari defending their territory. At least one defender must be Jarad Vod Savo, a Golgari Shaman, a Kraul Death Priest, an Undercity Medusa, or a Devkarin Lich. Count the lair as one additional CR 1 creature when estimating encounter difficulty.
On initiative count 20, losing ties, the group uses one lair action. It must choose a different option from the one used the previous round.
Sewer Overflow. Sewage spills from sewer openings the Golgari can see. A creature within 20 ft. of an affected opening must pass a DC 15 Dexterity save or fall prone and be pushed up to 20 ft. straight away from that opening.
Spore Cloud. Center a 20-ft.-radius sphere within 120 ft. of any member of the group. The spores spread around corners and lightly obscure the area. A creature inside when the cloud appears makes a DC 15 Constitution save, taking 10 (3d6) poison damage on a failure or half that damage on a success. A creature ending its turn inside takes 10 (3d6) poison damage. The cloud lasts until a Golgari defender dismisses it as an action, the group uses this option again, or all defenders die.
Fungal Tendrils. Center a 15-ft.-radius sphere within 60 ft. of any member of the group. Creatures in it who are not allied with the group must pass a DC 15 Dexterity save or become restrained. An affected creature can use its action to end the restraint on itself with a successful DC 15 Strength check. The restraint also ends if the group uses this option again, all defenders die, or no member remains within 60 ft. of the effect.

sections.title: Regional effects
lines: A Golgari lair produces one or both of these effects, only belowground. Moss and fungi cover underground surfaces within half a mile. When a Small or Medium humanoid dies within the lair, roll any die. On an odd result the corpse rises as a fungus drudge using the 2014 Zombie stat block after 1d8 hours, unless the body is destroyed first. If all Golgari in the lair die, its effects fade over 1d10 days.

lines:

Supreme Legal Authority. Choose up to three creatures Isperia can see within 90 ft. Each makes a DC 23 Intelligence saving throw. For each failure, choose one action the target cannot take for 1 minute: Attack, Cast a Spell, Dash, Disengage, Dodge, Help, Hide, Ready, Search, or Use an Object. The target can repeat the DC 23 Intelligence save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. sections.title: Traits
lines:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Niv-Mizzet can choose to succeed on a saving throw he failed.

Magic Resistance. Niv-Mizzet has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Master Chemister. When Niv-Mizzet casts a damaging spell, he can change its damage type to cold, fire, force, lightning, or thunder.

sections.title: Spellcasting
lines:
Niv-Mizzet is a 20th-level Izzet wizard. Intelligence is his spellcasting ability (DC 26, +18 to hit with spell attacks).
Cantrips (at will). Fire Bolt, Light, Prestidigitation, Ray of Frost, Shocking Grasp.
1st level (4 slots). Detect Magic, Magic Missile, Shield, Thunderwave, Unseen Servant.
2nd level (3 slots). Blur, Enlarge/Reduce, Flaming Sphere, Scorching Ray.
3rd level (3 slots). Counterspell, Fireball, Hold Person, Lightning Bolt, Slow.
4th level (3 slots). Confusion, Dimension Door, Fabricate.
5th level (2 slots). Conjure Elemental, Polymorph, Wall of Fire, Wall of Force.
6th level (1 slot). Chain Lightning, Disintegrate, True Seeing.
7th level (1 slot). Project Image, Reverse Gravity, Teleport.
8th level (1 slot). Control Weather, Maze, Power Word Stun.
9th level (1 slot). Prismatic Wall.

sections.title: Actions
lines:

sections.title: Legendary actions
lines:
Niv-Mizzet has three legendary actions and regains spent actions at the start of his turn. He can use one option at a time, at the end of another creature’s turn.
Cantrip (1 action). Cast a cantrip from his spell list.
Tail Attack (1 action). Make a Tail attack.
Wing Attack (2 actions). Each creature within 15 ft. must pass a DC 25 Dexterity save or take 14 (2d4 + 9) bludgeoning damage and fall prone. Niv-Mizzet can then fly up to half his flying speed.
Dracogenius (3 actions). Regain one expended spell slot of 3rd level or lower.

sections.title: Roleplaying
lines: Niv-Mizzet values invention, has spent more than ten thousand years studying the world, and quickly loses patience with people he thinks lack imagination.

1. Grasping Tendrils. The horror has four tendrils, each with AC 12 and 10 HP. Destroying a tendril does not harm the horror. As a bonus action, it can target a visible creature within 10 ft. The target must make a DC 19 Dexterity save or be grappled (escape DC 19). A tendril can hold only one target at a time.
2. Indomitable Mind. The horror becomes immune to being charmed.
3. Keen Senses. It gains advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight, sound, or smell.
4. Mind Sight. Magical darkness does not impede its darkvision.

sections.title: Traits
lines:
Inscrutable. The sphinx is immune to effects that sense its emotions or read its thoughts and to divination spells it chooses to refuse. Wisdom (Insight) checks to gauge its intentions or sincerity have disadvantage.
Magic Weapons. The sphinx's weapon attacks are magical.

sections.title: Spellcasting
lines:
The sphinx is a 9th-level Azorius wizard spellcaster. Intelligence sets its save DC to 16 and its spell attack bonus to +8. It casts these prepared spells without material components.
Cantrips (at will). Friends, Mage Hand, Message.
1st level (4 slots). Command, Ensnaring Strike, Shield.
2nd level (3 slots). Calm Emotions, Hold Person, Suggestion.
3rd level (3 slots). Clairvoyance, Counterspell, Dispel Magic.
4th level (3 slots). Banishment, Divination.
5th level (1 slot). Dominate Person.

sections.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Deal 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage on a hit.

sections.title: Legendary actions
lines:
The sphinx has 3 legendary actions and recovers spent actions at the start of its turn. It can take one option at a time, at the end of another creature's turn. It cannot use them while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, it must finish its first turn before it can use them.
Claw Attack (1 action). Make one Claw attack.
Teleport (2 actions). The sphinx and its worn or carried equipment magically move up to 120 ft. to a visible, unoccupied space.
Cast a Spell (3 actions). Cast a prepared spell, spending a spell slot as normal.

sections.title: Lair actions
lines:
When the sphinx is in its lair, it can choose one of these magical effects on initiative count 20, losing initiative ties. It must finish a short or long rest before it can repeat an effect. It cannot use a lair action while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, it must finish its first turn before it can use one.
Reroll initiative. Every creature in the lair rerolls initiative. The sphinx can keep its existing result.
Change age. Every creature in the lair makes a DC 15 Constitution save. On a failure it becomes 1d20 years older or younger, as the sphinx chooses. The creature cannot become younger than 1 year. Greater Restoration can restore its age.
Shift the lair in time. Move everything in the lair up to 10 years forward or backward. Only the sphinx notices immediately. Wish can return its caster and up to seven creatures the caster chooses to their normal time.
Shift planes. The sphinx transports itself and up to seven other creatures it can see in the lair to another plane. It cannot use lair actions while away. It can return to the lair as a bonus action on its turn and bring up to seven creatures with it.
